The ideal candidate thrives in a fast\-paced, remote consulting environment and manages competing priorities with minimal oversight. This position reports to and is managed by the CEO.


### **About Think and Ink Grant Consulting**


Founded in 2016 in Atlanta, GA, Think and Ink Grant Consulting® provides customized, practical, and real\-world solutions to help nonprofit organizations “think” through effective grant\-seeking strategies and “ink” competitive proposals. We are proud to be home to really smart, driven, and passionate people whose life mission is to do good in the world. Yes, we think they are cool too. If this sounds like you, check out our employment opportunities below.

**Operations Project Manager (Part\-Time)**

**Start Date:** **October 1, 2026**
===================================

**Location:** Remote (Atlanta, GA Preferred)

**Job Type:** Part\-time, hourly (W\-2 employee)

**Level:** Mid\-level

**Focus:** Operations and People Operations

**Time Commitment:** 20 hours per week

**Hourly Rate:** $30\.00 \- $40\.00 per hour

Yes, we think they are cool too. If this sounds like you, keep reading…

jobs.title: Program Manager
jobs.description:
At Clario, part of Thermo Fisher Scientific, we develop regulated technology that helps unlock better evidence and improve patient outcomes worldwide. Our software platforms support clinical trials, diagnostics, and medical decision\-making in highly controlled regulatory environments.


As a Program Manager within Project Management, you will serve as a key connection between our clients and operational teams, overseeing the relationship and delivery health across portfolios of clinical studies. You will bring together the right expertise to manage risks, drive consistency, strengthen client partnerships, and support successful delivery across assigned accounts. If you thrive in a dynamic, client\-facing environment where you can take ownership, influence decisions, and navigate complexity, we’d love to hear from you.

**What We Offer**
-----------------

* Competitive compensation
* Health, dental, and vision coverage
* 401(k) retirement plan with company match
* Paid time off and company holidays
* Wellness programs and Employee Assistance Program
* Flexible remote work options

**What You’ll Be Doing**
------------------------

* Oversee delivery health across one or more assigned client portfolios, maintaining visibility across multiple clinical studies and ensuring consistent execution against client expectations.
* Build trusted client relationships, understand priorities and challenges, and translate client needs into clear actions for Project Management teams, operational teams, and subject matter experts.
* Identify portfolio\-level delivery risks, manage escalations, drive timely resolution, and proactively address issues that could affect client satisfaction, revenue, or future opportunities.
* Monitor study timelines, financial performance, operational KPIs, and agreed processes across assigned accounts, using insights to support governance discussions and continuous improvement.
* Partner across the broader account team, including Business Development and Client Success, to support a consistent client experience, account strategy, retention, and long\-term growth.
* Prepare for and participate in client governance and operational meetings, communicating effectively with stakeholders and providing clear recommendations and direction.

**What We Look For**
--------------------

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant experience.
* 4–8 years of relevant experience in pharmaceuticals, clinical research, eCOA, or a related client\-facing project, program, portfolio, or account environment.
* Demonstrated experience managing complex client relationships and coordinating delivery across multiple projects, studies, or workstreams.
* Knowledge of the drug development process; experience with eCOA or clinical study delivery is preferred.
* Strong judgment and the confidence to make decisions, manage difficult conversations, and constructively challenge stakeholders while maintaining trusted relationships.
* Proactive, adaptable, and comfortable operating independently in an environment where priorities can change and solutions are not always defined by established processes.
* Excellent organizational, prioritization, stakeholder\-management, and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to balance portfolio\-level visibility with important operational detail.
* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills and the ability to work effectively across multidisciplinary and geographically distributed teams.
* Ability to work remotely within the United States and travel periodically for client or business meetings.


At Clario, our purpose is to transform lives by unlocking better evidence. It’s a cause that unites and inspires us. It’s why we come to work—and how we empower our people to make a positive impact every day. Whether you're advancing clinical science, building innovative technology, or supporting our global teams, your work helps bring life\-changing therapies to patients faster.  

  

Clario is an equal opportunity employer. Clario evaluates qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, disability/handicap status, or any other legally protected characteristic.

jobs.description:
**Cloud/AI Delivery Manager**

Promevo, LLC was founded in 2001 by a group of experienced systems integration, application development, and systems administration specialists in Cincinnati, OH.  

  

**We are Promevo!**  

  

The name Promevo is derived from the Latin words promoveo, meaning "to move ahead" and promereo, meaning "to earn". It’s our name, but it’s also our purpose. We **move clients ahead** in technology, enabling their competitive advantage and we **earn their trust** with our technical excellence and dedication to their success. We believe that digital solutions shouldn’t be something our clients need to adapt to, instead we make digital solutions adapt to client needs.  

  

Promevo is a Google Premier Partner for Google Workspace, Google Cloud, and Google Chrome, specializing in helping businesses harness the power of Google and the opportunities of AI. From technical support and implementation to expert consulting and custom solutions like gPanel, we empower organizations to optimize operations and accelerate growth in the AI era.  

  

In addition to Google technology, Promevo's SaaS Platform (gPanel) provides our clients with a centralized user management interface providing administrators with visibility and control over all of their users' data and settings with its robust suite of security features. We walk alongside our clients to help them achieve their digital transformation and infrastructure goals by providing Professional Services such as migrations, custom app development, fast track deployments, and white glove services.
  

  

This is an exciting time to be part of Promevo as we are growing rapidly. We are seeking an experienced Cloud/AI Delivery Manager (**Project Manager)** with a strong background in Agile methodology to join our team. The ideal candidate will have a track record of successfully delivering complex IT projects on time, within budget, and meeting stakeholder expectations. Familiarity with Google Cloud Platform is a plus, as well as HIPAA and other compliance knowledge.  

  

By joining the Promevo Team, you will find that our company culture is at the heart of our success. Promevo’s core values center around building trust, investing in care of each other, owning our work, respecting our differences, and engaging in positive attitudes. By living out these values each day, we build supportive teams that nurture development and growth, both individually and professionally.  

  

Our Promevo team members are committed to living out the core values below:
* **Build and Extend Trust –** Show respect and listen. Do what you say you will do. Be transparent and dependable.
* **Keep it Human** – Invest in relationships. Show empathy. Do right by others. Take care of yourself, your family, and each other.
* **Own It** – Become an expert in your role. Own the outcome. Finish what you start. Answer for the results.
* **Differences Make Us Stronger –** Respect Differences. Seek to include different perspectives. Learn from each other.
* **Attitude is Contagious** – Be fully engaged. Take pride in what you do. Spread your positivity. Courage. Energy. Passion. Purpose.

  

**Duties and Responsibilities**
* Manage end\-to\-end IT project delivery (specifically managing cloud delivery projects in Google Cloud), including planning, scoping, budgeting, resource allocation, risk management, and stakeholder management.
* Act as a liaison between clients, technical delivery teams and other organizational units to ensure clear communication, alignment on objectives, and shared success metrics.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including developers, designers, architects, testers, and other stakeholders to ensure timely delivery of projects.
* Collaborate with Sales, Client Success and Technology Leadership to establish and implement best practices that enhance project efficiency and customer satisfaction
* Communicate effectively with clients, technical teams and executive leadership, translating complex technical details into achievable project deliverables and timelines.
* Ensure that projects are delivered within scope, budget, and timeline constraints while meeting quality standards and stakeholder expectations.
* Implement project management methodology, appropriate to the project, to enable fast delivery, high quality, and excellent stakeholder engagement.
* Provide regular project status updates to stakeholders, including senior management and other project sponsors.
* Ensure that project delivery is aligned with organizational goals and objectives.
* Identify and deliver process improvements, best practices, and automation opportunities to enable excellent project delivery.
* Become Google certified as a Digital Cloud Leader within the first 60 days of hire


**Skills and Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree
* 7\+ years of experience in IT project management, required
* Familiarity with Google technologies is required
* Experience leading technology projects leveraging Google Cloud \& Google Workspace
* Strong experience with project management methodologies (including Agile)
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, including the ability to work collaboratively with cross\-functional teams.
* Strong organizational skills, including the ability to manage multiple projects and priorities.
* Strong leadership skills, including the ability to motivate and lead a team to achieve project goals.
* Familiarity with project management tools, such as Jira, Asana, or Trello.


**What Promevo Offers**

jobs.title: Senior Data Analyst
jobs.description:
**Senior Data Analyst**

**About Program Performance \& Planning**  

In full partnership with families and communities, Graham Windham strives to make a life\-altering difference with children, youth and families who are overcoming some of life’s most difficult challenges and obstacles, by helping to build a strong foundation for life: a safe, loving, permanent family and the opportunity and preparation to thrive in school and in the world. The Program Performance and Planning (PPP) group advances a culture of learning, strategic program development, and data\-driven performance management in pursuit of that mission and vision. PPP partners with program managers to select and develop new interventions, analyze and interpret data, assess model fidelity and program effectiveness, apply learning from data analysis and feedback into program improvement efforts, and develop program resources to strengthen operations and service delivery.




**About the Position**  

PPP seeks a **Senior** **Data Analyst** to build and maintain reports and dashboards that support all of Graham’s work. This will entail close collaboration with our IT department, specifically a data engineer, to ensure that we have all necessary data in our data warehouse, develop and maintain a robust enterprise\-level data model, produce and maintain automated reports and dashboards, run ad hoc queries and analyses, and maintain the library of data assets that are used by leadership across the agency. This position will also support the development and use of tools in Microsoft Excel, Forms, PowerApps, and more to ensure teams have strong data collection and management practices.


This position will work deeply with data from all units across Graham including foster care, preventive services, mental health, care coordination, youth coaching, and community centers. This position will interface with the rest of the PPP team who collaborate with leadership and staff to generate insight from the data and develop plans for achieving excellence in operations and outcomes.




The ideal candidate will have strong data analysis skills, be curious and inquisitive, and think creatively about how to ensure our data is complete and accurate. This person will be interested in exploring how artificial intelligence (AI) tools can be useful in supporting the data work of Graham, in line with our strong privacy and confidentiality practices.

  



  

**Responsibilities:**

* Design, build, and maintain Power BI dashboards and reports, including data modeling, DAX calculations, and query optimization within Power Query (M).
* Own and manage the Power BI workspace structure, including workspace organization, dataset/dataflow management, row\-level security, version control, and refresh scheduling.
* Partner with IT/database colleagues on the design and evolution of the enterprise data model, ensuring source tables, relationships, and data elements support accurate and scalable reporting.
* Conduct ad\-hoc and recurring analyses using SQL, Power BI, Excel, and Power Query to answer business questions, evaluate program performance, and support decision\-making.
* Document data definitions, table structures, dashboard logic, and query/report methodology to support consistency, auditability, and knowledge transfer.
* Translate stakeholder requests into technical requirements, and communicate analytical findings clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences, including through presentations and facilitated discussions.
* Coach and support program staff in interpreting dashboards and data, promoting broader data literacy across the organization.
* Other related duties as assigned.

**Competencies and Strengths**:




In keeping with the Graham Pillars of Respect, Grow, Thrive, and Lead and the requirements of the position, the following competencies and strengths are important attributes for being successful in this role:

* Detailed \& Organized: Extremely detail\-oriented, with excellent written and oral skills.
* Supportive and Learning Oriented Coach: Has an aptitude for coaching others and an orientation toward using data and information to support a culture of learning and improvement
* Curious: Interested in understanding why things are the way they are and persistent about figuring things out.
* Engaged: Communicates openly, honestly and clearly and is willing to have healthy disagreement, with the goal of building a more connected community.

Meta is seeking a Strategic Risk Program Manager to lead privacy risk governance and program strategy across the company's global product and infrastructure portfolio. In this role, you will define and operationalize frameworks for identifying, assessing, and mitigating privacy risks at scale, partnering with legal, policy, engineering, and product teams to embed risk management practices into how Meta builds and ships products. You will drive cross\-functional alignment on privacy risk posture, influence executive decision\-making, and shape the long\-term direction of Meta's privacy risk programs in a complex and rapidly evolving regulatory environment.  

  

  

### **Strategic Risk Program Manager, Privacy Responsibilities:**

* Define and own the strategic framework for privacy risk identification, assessment, prioritization, and mitigation across Meta's product and infrastructure landscape
* Lead cross\-functional programs that translate privacy regulatory requirements and internal policy commitments into scalable operational processes
* Partner with legal, policy, engineering, and product teams to embed privacy risk controls into product development lifecycles and launch processes
* Develop and maintain privacy risk reporting mechanisms, including executive\-level dashboards and governance committee materials that communicate risk posture and program health
* Drive alignment across organizational boundaries on privacy risk decisions, escalation paths, and accountability structures
* Identify systemic gaps in privacy risk coverage and design programs to close them, including tooling, process, and policy improvements
* Represent privacy risk program strategy in cross\-functional forums, regulatory engagement preparation, and senior leadership reviews
* Establish metrics and key performance indicators to measure the effectiveness of privacy risk programs and drive continuous improvement
* Mentor other program managers on privacy risk methodology, governance best practices, and cross\-functional program execution
* Anticipate emerging privacy risks from new product areas, technologies, and regulatory developments and proactively shape program responses

* Experience communicating privacy risk strategy and program status to executive audiences through written materials, briefings, and governance forums
* Experience translating privacy regulatory requirements (such as GDPR, CCPA, or equivalent frameworks) into operational program requirements and controls

jobs.title: Specialist, Network Security Analyst
jobs.description:
Job Classification:


Technology \- Information Security
 Are you interested in building capabilities that enable the organization with innovation, speed, agility, scalability, and efficiency? The Global Technology team takes great pride in our culture where digital transformation is built into our DNA. When you join our organization, you will unlock an exciting and impactful career while growing your skills and advancing your profession at one of the world's leading financial services institutions.

 **Your Team \& Role**


As a Specialist, Network Security Analyst within the Network Security Strategy \& Analysis team within the ISO Infrastructure Security team, you will use network, security, asset, configuration, and vulnerability data to identify risk, quantify technical debt, evaluate control effectiveness, and support strategic network security decisions. You will partner with Network Engineering, Network Security Operations, Infrastructure, Cloud, Identity, Architecture, and other security teams to convert complex data into validated findings, prioritized recommendations, dashboards, and measurable risk\-reduction actions. You will explain complex concepts and influence others to adopt data\-supported points of view while working on complex problems that require an in\-depth evaluation of security controls and business context.


This role does not own day\-to\-day administration or operations of network security platforms; instead, this team will use analysis to drive environmental hardening and risk reduction. Success requires technical depth, strategic thinking, strong analytical judgment, and the ability to lead work through influence across multiple teams.

**Here Is What You Can Expect on a Typical Day**

* Collect, normalize, correlate, and analyze data from SIEM, firewall, proxy, ZTNA, NAC, network, vulnerability, asset, CMDB, IPAM, endpoint, and identity sources.
* Identify unmanaged assets, insecure access paths, legacy technologies, control gaps, configuration weaknesses, segmentation issues, and other areas of network security technical debt.
* Build repeatable analytics, queries, dashboards, and reports that measure network security posture, exposure, control coverage, risk\-reduction progress, and data quality.
* Perform complex analysis independently with minimal assistance, documenting methods, assumptions, limitations, validation steps, and recommended actions.
* Partner with network, infrastructure, application, cloud, identity, and security teams to validate findings, resolve data discrepancies, and establish accountable remediation plans.
* Support current\-state assessments and strategy work for NAC, segmentation, Zero Trust, ZTNA, firewall modernization, proxy transformation, and related capabilities.
* Translate analytical findings into concise risk statements, decision\-ready summaries, visualizations, and presentations for technical and leadership audiences.
* Maintain a network security risk and technical\-debt inventory, including evidence, ownership, prioritization, dependencies, status, and risk\-acceptance information.
* Automate recurring data preparation, quality checks, correlation, and reporting where practical and maintain clear process and query documentation.
* Continuously improve analytical methods, data sources, metrics, and validation processes based on stakeholder feedback and evolving risk priorities.
**The Skills \& Expertise You Bring**

* Bachelor of Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Data Analytics, or equivalent experience in related fields.
* Applied experience in cybersecurity, network engineering, security analytics, risk analysis, or a related technical discipline.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, including the ability to work with incomplete or inconsistent enterprise data and produce defensible conclusions.
* Experience developing queries, dashboards, metrics, or reports using security and technology data.
* Ability to independently manage assigned analysis and project work while escalating material risks, blockers, and data\-quality concerns appropriately.
* Knowledge of business concepts and information security tools and processes needed to make sound decisions within the company context.
* Experience with agile ways of working and collaboration across geographically and functionally diverse teams.
* Excellent written communication, presentation, documentation, and collaboration skills.
**Applied Experience with Several of the Following**

* Splunk or comparable SIEM and analytics platforms, including search development, field normalization, lookups, dashboards, and scheduled reporting.
* SQL, Python, PowerShell, or comparable methods for data manipulation, correlation, automation, and quality validation.
* Firewall, proxy, ZTNA, NAC, DNS, flow, routing, switching, authentication, and remote\-access telemetry, including Zscaler data where applicable.
* Asset inventories, CMDB, IPAM, endpoint\-management, identity, vulnerability\-management, and ServiceNow data.
* Network concepts such as IP addressing, subnets, VLANs, routing, ACLs, firewall policy, NAT, segmentation, and application connectivity.
* Information Security risk assessments, control testing, issue management, exception processes, and technical\-debt tracking.
* NIST and ISO 27000 standards, CIS Controls, Zero Trust concepts, and information security control standards and engineering specifications.
* Data visualization, KPI/KRI design, trend analysis, executive reporting, and measurement of control effectiveness and remediation outcomes.
**Preferred Qualifications**

* Security, networking, analytics, cloud, Splunk, Zscaler, or GIAC certification.
* Experience analyzing data in a large enterprise with multiple network and security platforms.
* Experience supporting network segmentation, NAC, Zero Trust, firewall\-rule analysis, or technical\-debt reduction initiatives.
**You'll Love Working Here Because You Can*

**Preferred Qualifications**

* CISSP, CCSP, CISM, SANS GIAC,

The Project Manager oversees the planning, coordination, execution, and performance of assigned projects, task orders, and operational initiatives. This role ensures project objectives are met within defined scope, schedule, budget, quality, and contractual requirements while serving as the primary coordination point for execution.

 **Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
**POSITION TITLE:** Project Manager**WORK LOCATION:** Remote**CLEARANCE REQUIRED:** N/A **ABOUT US:**  

At Intact Technology, we are driven by a shared commitment to customer success, employee fulfillment, and meaningful impact. We combine human ingenuity with intelligent tools to deliver smarter solutions, faster outcomes, and exceptional value for our clients and partners.  

We operate in an AI\-enabled, outcome\-based delivery model, where technology accelerates execution and our teams focus on judgment, problem solving, client impact, and accountability. Success at Intact requires the ability to leverage tools effectively while applying a critical, thoughtful approach to client solutions and delivery outcomes.  

Our culture is built around individuality, autonomy, and empowerment, with the freedom to think creatively, act boldly, and make an impact. We support that with a flexible work environment, comprehensive benefits, and continued investment in learning and career growth.  

  

**THE ROLE:**
We’re currently building our Project Manager pipeline for anticipated upcoming ServiceNow transformation initiatives. We’re looking to connect with experienced professionals as we prepare for future project needs.  

In this role, you will lead end\-to\-end ServiceNow engagements across a range of platform capabilities. You will serve as the primary client\-facing project lead, managing scope, schedule, budget, risks, and team accountability while ensuring delivery aligns with business objectives and measurable outcomes.  

  

**TO BE SUCCESSFUL HERE YOU WILL:** **Drive Outcome\-Based ServiceNow Delivery*** Manage projects across one or more platform products and workflows, based on client and program needs.
* Ensure delivery aligns with measurable operational improvements such as SLA attainment, reduced MTTR, improved change success rate, and strengthened CMDB maturity.
* Coordinate cross\-functional efforts spanning:
	+ **ITOM** (Discovery, Service Mapping, Event Management)
	+ **ITAM** (asset lifecycle management, compliance, inventory governance)
	+ **HRSD** (employee case management, service delivery workflows)
* Maintain clear alignment between business objectives and platform execution.

 **Plan, Execute, and Govern*** Develop and manage detailed project plans aligned to contractual scope and customer requirements.
* Track schedule, budget, risks, dependencies, and resource allocation.
* Facilitate issue resolution and proactively manage project risks.
* Support Agile/Scrum ceremonies and structured delivery practices.
* Maintain documentation, reporting, and governance standards consistent with consulting best practices.
* Leverage AI and intelligent tools to improve project planning, reporting, risk identification, documentation, and overall delivery efficiency.

 **Client \& Stakeholder Management*** Build and maintain strong client and subcontractor relationships.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for project stakeholders.
* Communicate status, risks, and outcomes clearly and consistently.
* Ensure delivery of high\-quality work and a positive customer experience.

 **Team Leadership \& Culture*** Provide ongoing feedback, guidance, and development support to project team members.
* Foster accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Promote Intact’s culture and values within each engagement.

 **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:*** 5\+ years of progressive experience in a project management role
* Experience managing ServiceNow delivery engagements, particularly ITSM\-focused implementations
* Working familiarity with ITOM, ITAM, and/or HRSD initiatives
* Experience managing ServiceNow delivery engagements across one or more ServiceNow Products or solution areas.
* Strong understanding of IT Service Management (ITSM) principles and IT operational processes
* Experience working with commercial and/or federal clients
* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration or related field (or equivalent experience)
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to effectively leverage AI and digital tools to enhance productivity, decision\-making, and project delivery.
* Strong interpersonal skills and emotional intelligence
* Ability to manage competing priorities and perform under pressure
 **NICE TO HAVE QUALIFICATIONS:*** PMP, PMI\-ACP, or similar project management certification
* ServiceNow platform experience and/or relevant certification
* Experience managing fixed\-price and/or outcome\-based engagements
* Experience coordinating subcontractors or multi\-vendor teams
 **OUR TALENT VISION:*** We take ownership in our customers’ success, delivering excellence with purpose and precision, every time.
* We’re passionate about harnessing innovation, data, and the power of AI to create meaningful outcomes that drive transformation for our clients and communities.
* Our people are innovators, thinkers, and problem\-solvers, blending human creativity with cutting\-edge technology to design smarter, faster, more sustainable solutions.
* Our culture values individuality and empowerment. We trust our teams to take initiative, think critically, and use emerging tools like AI to elevate how we work, learn, and deliver value.
* We actively support a healthy blend between work and life and believe that sustainable performance comes from collaboration, curiosity, and continuous improvement.
 **OUR BENEFITS:*** Ongoing personal and professional development opportunities.
* Flexible paid time off, plus 12 paid holidays.
* Premium healthcare plans — Medical, Dental, Vision — including HSA and FSA options.
* Qualified 401(k) program.

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS**
This position is primarily sedentary and requires the ability to maintain focus on computer screens for extended periods. Frequent virtual interaction with clients and team members is necessary to clearly articulate ideas and information. The role involves extensive reading, transcribing, and repetitive hand and wrist

jobs.title: Program Analyst (Remote in DMV + Travel )
jobs.description:
**Program Analyst \- Performance \& Controls (Digital PMO)**

**Location: D.C/ Maryland/ Virginia**  

**Type: Remote \+ Travel as needed to Annapolis, Maryland and Aberdeen, Maryland**  

**Salary Range:** $80,000\- $95,000

**Program Analyst**


Fairwinds Technologies, LLC is looking for a Program Analyst to manage projects, financials and support program managers with large complex program awards and handle the day\-to\-day activities within the program management office. This position will work directly for the VP of PMO and in parallel with operations, accounting and sales. We are looking for someone who can manage customer expectations, develop/edit reports and schedule work efforts across the business unit. The position will work with internal and external customers requiring them to think on their feet and leverage a proven ability to brief decision makers and support staff alike to develop customer organizational consensus.


 Location: Hybrid, Annapolis Maryland and at Fairwinds facilities, and customer sites


 Compensation: Base Salary


 Supervisor: VP of PMO


 Minimum Qualifications:

* BA/BS Degree (or equivalent)
* **Minimum 3 years with government contracting / DoD Experience**
* Project based accounting/finance experience, managing costs and schedules with customers and vendors
* Demonstrated ability to communicate, present and influence credibly and effectively at all levels of the organization.
* Ability to prioritize, multi\-task, and perform effectively under pressure.
* Must be a US Citizen


Responsibilities:

* Project planning, budgeting/ forecasting, Invoicing, and overall project strategy
* Analyzing project data to optimize performance, identify problems and shortfalls and propose solutions.
* Review project contracts and financials
* Manage customer expectations, schedule updates, deliveries, tracking , etc.
* Coordinate the activities of the program(s) and set priorities for their execution
* Formulate, organize, and monitor inter\-connected projects
* Development of customer and internal briefs as needed
* Apply change, risk, and resource management
* Ability to review customer documents and create reports for submission as required
* Ability to work remotely and communicate effectively
* Excellent organizational, communication and presentation skills
* Proficient in MS Office
* Adheres to company policies, procedures, and practices
* Ability to obtain a security clearance as needed
* Close attention to detail and the ability to plan ahead

 **Physical Demands**


While performing the duties of this job, the employee is occasionally required to stand; walk; sit; use hands to finger, handle, or feel objects, tools or controls; use fingers and hands to type or write; reach with hands and arms; talk or hear. Specific vision abilities required by the job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception

**Position Type/Expected Hours of Work**


This is a full\-time, exempt position, working Monday through Friday; 40 hours per work week; occasional evening and weekend work may be required as job duties demand. Some flexibility in actual work hours may be offered.

**Travel**


Must be willing to travel 5–10%

**Work Authorization/Security Clearance**


Must be eligible to work in the US and with the ability to obtain a secret level clearance.

**Other Duties**


Please note that this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

**AAP/EEO Statement**


Fairwinds Technologies, LLC is an Equal Opportunity Employer – M/F/Veteran/Disability/Sexual Orientation/Gender Identity

At Fairwinds, we consider many factors when it comes to compensation, including the scope of the position as well as your background and experience. Base pay may vary depending on job\-related knowledge, skills, location and experience. Additional incentives may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to a range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits.

jobs.title: Cyber Security Program Manager
jobs.description:
Overview:

Millennium is proud to be part of the Markon enterprise, a network of specialized organizations united in support of critical national security missions. This partnership strengthens our ability to deliver results by expanding our technical depth, operational reach, and access to a broader bench of proven experts, ensuring our customers continue to receive best\-in\-class cybersecurity support.  

  

Since 2004, Millennium has operated at the forefront of cybersecurity. Our elite team of over 300 professionals brings an unmatched record of performance across Red Team Operations, Defensive Cyber Operations, Software Engineering, and Technical Engineering. As home to the largest contingent of contracted Red Team operators supporting the Department of Defense, Millennium delivers unparalleled threat intelligence and battle\-tested expertise to both DoD and federal civilian customers.
What We Believe:

Millennium is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate or allow discrimination on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, age, national origin, citizenship, disability, veteran status or any other classification protected by federal, state, or local law.
Responsibilities:

Millennium Corporation is hiring a **Cybersecurity Program Manager to work in Washington DC**. The Candidate must have **an active TS/SCI clearance.** **Basic Duties**\-* Assessment and Authorization, IT security risk management, and continuous monitoring of DHS IE IT systems
* Integration of information assurance and cybersecurity engineering practices throughout DevSecOps activities for developing information technology (IT) systems and components
* Information security in hybrid cloud\-based environments (i.e. IC Cloud, DHS IE C2E Enclave (DICE), C\-LAN, Cross Domain Services (CDS) GovCloud, Rapid Requirements and Data Development Environment (R2D2E) standalone systems.)
* Information security architecture and systems engineering
* Innovation, automation, efficiencies, and continual improvement in IT security processes and technologies, and tracking metrics to monitor improvements
* Provisioning and managing communications security (COMSEC) equipment
* Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning (AI/ML) capabilities
* Experience using MS Office tools, JIRA, and Confluence as well as the ability to generate reports, presentations, metrics, and other data necessary to support bid decisions.


Qualifications:
* Candidate must have an active TS/SCI Clearance
* Bachelor's degree and must have at least 15 years of demonstrated experience managing projects of similar size and scope.
* The Project Manager shall possess a Project Management Professional (PMP) certification and a Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP) or Certified Information Security Manager (CISM) certification, in good standing, at the time of contract award and throughout the period of performance.
* In\-depth knowledge of IC and Cyber Security Contract management


Business Development:

Assist with Business Development activities as required to support Millennium's strategic business objectives, which may include but not limited to participation in technical interviews, creation of technical documentation, general proposal writing support and proposal color reviews.
Physical Requirements:
* Must be comfortable with prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
* Must be able to lift up to 10\-15 pounds at a time.


Travel Requirements:

10%


COMPENSATION::

$175,000\-$185,000

  

The salary range provided for this position is intended as a general guideline and does not guarantee a specific salary or compensation amount. Final compensation will be determined based on a variety of factors, including, relevant education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities

jobs.title: TSA Program Manager - Clearance Required
jobs.description:
Overview:

LMI is seeking a skilled **Program Manager** at our headquarters office in Tysons Corner, VA. The Program Manager will lead a Transportation Security Administration (TSA) single award Blanket Purchase Agreement. In this role, the Program Manager will serve as the single point of contact for TSA leadership, lead all staffing for task orders, be accountable for management and submission of contract deliverables, and manage overall BPA performance while upholding the highest standard of ethical behavior. The Program Manager will have regular meetings with TSA personnel in Springfield, VA, requiring the candidate to live in the DC metro region.  

LMI is a new breed of digital solutions provider dedicated to accelerating government impact with innovation and speed. Investing in technology and prototypes ahead of need, LMI brings commercial\-grade platforms and mission\-ready AI to federal agencies at commercial speed.  

Leveraging our mission\-ready technology and solutions, proven expertise in federal deployment, and strategic relationships, we enhance outcomes for the government, efficiently and effectively. Reinventing Geospatial (RGi) is a leading expert in geospatial solutions for Defense, Intelligence, and Federal clients. We enhance situational awareness for soldiers and analysts by integrating software development with geospatial intelligence. Our projects range from data collection to advanced deep learning, leveraging tools like Python, Java, and ArcGIS.

We don't just fill roles we build teams of high performers and leaders who make an immediate impact. At our core, we're driven by innovation and powered by people who work at the intersection of passion and performance. Here, you'll collaborate with bold thinkers, leverage cutting edge technology, and tackle meaningful challenges from day one.

Our culture is defined and anchored by three pillars:

**Energy:** We bring passion, purpose, and urgency to our work.
**Edge:** We take initiative, embrace growth, and step outside our comfort zone.
**Execution:** We get things done smartly, decisively, and with real results.

If you're the kind of person who leads with initiative, thrives in a fast\-paced environment, and is eager to create real impact, we want you on our team.
### **As a Big Data Analyst you will...**


* Responsible for performing and developing dataset evaluations and assessments to inform government decision making.
* Shaping data engineering approaches for analytic tradecraft improvements within our applications.
* Identifying and documenting gaps within our data corpus and analytical capabilities.
* Working hand\-in\-hand with software developers to field requirements and provide feedback as changes are implemented into an application.
* Working with end\-users to provide SME support for various data or application questions and requests.
### **Big Data Analyst Qualifications:**


* Must have a current/active TS/SCI and be willing and able to obtain a CI polygraph.
* Bachelors degree in a relevant field. Equivalent years of experience may be substituted in lieu of a degree.
* At least 5 years of experience as a data analyst, data scientist or similar.
* Experience formulating a repeatable process for data evaluations and communicating findings to government officials.
* In\-depth knowledge of technical data types based on previous research and work with data sets of interest. Data types of interest include Technical Telemetry Data and other forms of telecommunication protocol data types, including cellular and wi\-fi.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Must be a self\-starter with excellent time\-management skills and the ability to independently manage multiple concurrent tasks.
* Must be experienced working in fast\-paced environments.
* Experience working with Software Engineers to provide feedback and validate the technical implementation for custom applications.
* Experience working with a scripting language like Python, SQL, Spark, PySpark or similar.
* Must be able to work on\-site in Herndon, VA, with the ability to work in Springfield, VA as needed.
### **Things we would like to see...**


* Ability to translate technical conclusions and present them to a broader audience.
* Experience conducting geospatial analysis including Activity\-Based Intelligence or Pattern of Life analysis.
* Experience applying, improving, and documenting innovative analytic methodologies and ensuring they remain up to date with the latest information.
* Experience with Elasticsearch/Kibana.
* Experience in a customer facing role.
* Familiarity with Gitlab and the Software Development Lifecycle.
* Experience working with Jupyter Notebooks or Apache Zepplin.
* Experience working with other intel analysts and/or special operations customers.
$130,000 \- $190,000 a year* *Salary commensurate with experience.*

Reinventing Geospatial, Inc. (RGi) is a fast\-paced small business that has the environment and culture of a start\-up, with the stability and benefits of a well\-established firm. We solve complex problems within geospatial software development and national defense to make an Immediate Impact for our nation’s soldiers and analysts.  

We pride ourselves on giving employees an exceptional life experience, where creativity thrives, and challenges are simply part of the fun. We provide truly excellent benefits, including:* 100% paid employee healthcare \& dental insurance
* Paid parental leave

jobs.title: PROJECT - Analytics and Insights Engineer III - Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Our Deloitte AI \& Engineering team works to transform technology platforms, drive innovation, and help make a significant impact on our clients' success. You'll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and reengineering operations and processes that are critical to businesses. Your contributions can help clients improve financial performance, accelerate new digital ventures, and fuel growth through innovation.  

**Work you'll do**  

As an Analytics and Insights Engineer III on the AI \& Data team, you will be responsible for...  

* Designing, building, and maintaining data pipelines, curated data sets, and analytics solutions that support client reporting and mission needs
* Developing and enhancing analytics, search, and data discovery capabilities using Python, Structured Query Language (SQL), and platform tools
* Analyzing structured and unstructured data to identify patterns, generate insights, and support investigative use cases
* Collaborating with client stakeholders and technical teams to translate business needs into scalable data and analytics solutions
* Performing testing, documentation, deployment support, and data quality activities to maintain reliable outputs and continuous improvement

  

A successful candidate would possess these skills:  

* Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
* Effective written and verbal communication skills
* Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
* Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
* Ability to lead projects or workstreams
* Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast\-paced and dynamic environment
* Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
* Ability to meet deadlines
* Ability to provide clear guidance to others

  

**The team**  

  

Deloitte's Government \& Public Services (GPS) practice \- our people, ideas, technology and outcomes \- is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, \& local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.  

  

Our AI \& Data offering provides a full spectrum of solutions for designing, developing, and operating cutting\-edge Data and AI platforms, products, insights, and services. Our offerings help clients innovate, enhance and operate their data, AI, and analytics capabilities, ensuring they can mature and scale effectively.  

  

The Project Delivery Talent Model is designed for professionals with specialized skills that align to a current client need. Team members focus on delivering services to clients, without additional expectations related to business development or promotion. Their employment is tied to their role on a project, and they are eligible for a benefits package that is competitive for project delivery\-focused professionals.  

  

**Qualifications**  

  

Required:  

* Bachelor's degree
* 5\+ years of experience designing, building, and supporting data, analytics, or business intelligence solutions
* 4\+ years of experience with Python
* 3\+ years of experience using Structured Query Language (SQL)
* Active Top Secret clearance with completed adjudication and ability to obtain Sensitive Compartmented Information (SCI)
* Ability to travel 0\-10%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
* Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

  

Preferred:  

* 1\+ year of experience with R programming language
* 1\+ year of experience with OpenSearch or Elasticsearch
* 1\+ year of experience in an investigator role

  

For individuals assigned and/or hired to work in Washington DC, Deloitte is required by law to include a reasonable estimate of the compensation range for this role. This compensation range is specific to Washington DC and takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $113,000 to $188,400\.  

  

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

jobs.title: Strategic Business Analyst
jobs.description:
Company Overview:

By Light Professional IT Services LLC readies warfighters and federal agencies with technology and systems engineered to connect, protect, and prepare individuals and teams for whatever comes next. Headquartered in McLean, VA, By Light supports defense, civilian, and commercial IT customers worldwide.
Position Overview:

Information Manager/Knowledge Manager to work as part of a dynamic Knowledge Management (KM) Team in support DoD Cyber Defense Command at Fort Meade, MD. As a key team member, you will support the operational information needs for real time cyberspace defensive operations that are executed across the Department of Defense.
Responsibilities:
* Serve as the forward extension of the KM team within the staff to enhance the effectiveness of KM efforts in the directorates.
* Support the implementation of Knowledge Management efforts in the directorates across all domains \- people, processes, and tools.
* Serve as a Content Manager for specified directorates
* Provide the ability to translate operational requirements into logical and integrated technical solutions; advise the staff members on holistic methodologies to accomplish their tasks and missions given their respective problem sets.
* Provide the ability to design, document and orchestrate doctrinally sound processes to support operational mission requirements.
* Proactively make recommendations for process enhancements and new process development.
* Provide moderate technical expertise, oversight and control in communications, time management, quality assurance, quality control and management, process development and risk management. The contractor shall also provide a team that shall:
* Provide support to Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) requests from higher headquarters or through the task management system.
* Provide support to Records Management efforts to include Development of “meta data tagging” efforts and developing structure.


Required Experience/Qualifications:
* Foundational working Knowledge in Information Management (IM) /Knowledge Management (KM)
* SharePoint End User
* Basic Understanding of SharePoint Out\-of\-the\-Box Features
* Experience with Microsoft Office Products
* Effective communication and presentation skills (verbal and written)


Preferred Experience/Qualifications:
* SharePoint experience with creating sites, editing pages, list items, and changing site permissions
* Familiar with SharePoint Designer
* Records Management Experience
* Process Development
* Bachelor’s Degree


Special Requirements/Security Clearance:
* Active DoD TS/SCI clearance


Salary Range:

Based on the roles, responsibilities, and requirements, the projected pay range for this position is: $120,000 \- $160,000\.  

The annual base salary provided is a guideline for this position and is not a guarantee of compensation or salary. When extending an offer, By Light also considers other variables such as (but not limited to) work experience, education, training, skill set, internal peer equity, clearance level, and market conditions. In addition, By Light provides an extensive selection of benefits and offerings to our employees.

jobs.title: Building Technologies Office Program Analyst
jobs.description:
Boston Government Services, LLC. (BGS) is seeking a **Building Technologies Office Program Analyst** to support our clients in Washington, DC.

  

BGS is an engineering, technology, and security firm helping to advance missions of national importance for government programs, national laboratories, national security facilities, nuclear operations, and complex projects. We support clients at every stage, from strategic planning and program management to the execution of engineering and technical activities. We work to attract and retain the best talent because the best talent delivers the best results for our clients. Our capabilities are based on our experience in complex, secure, and highly regulated environments. We leverage our experience and capabilities to provide mission\-driven solutions tuned to our client's mission needs and strategic direction.

 **Work that Matters. People that Matter More.** At BGS, we believe meaningful work starts with great people. We foster a culture built on respect, collaboration, and accountability—where employees are empowered to contribute ideas, grow professionally, and make an impact. We care about our employees’ well\-being through competitive benefits, clear expectations, and an environment that values both excellence and connection.

  

If you align with BGS’ company values and culture, we would love for you to explore opportunities to join our growing team by checking out the job description below!

  

Supports the Department of Energy (DOE) Office of Critical Minerals and Energy Innovation (CMEI) in program logistics and project management for the Emerging Technologies (ET) office. Support involves day to day interactions with internal parties such as legal, contracting, NEPA, and communications; as well as external communication with project recipients in academia, private industry, and National Laboratories.

  

Position will provide crosscutting support to technical program offices including:

* Assistance in project management, performance monitoring, documentation, and progress assessment for DOE funded projects.
* Technical reviews of engineering research portfolios including evaluation of Windows and building envelope research, data analysis, and development of briefing materials and presentations.
* Assist in development of competitive solicitations, lab calls, and merit reviews/reviewers (Includes FOAs/NOFOs, SBIR, STTR, TCF).
* Requires a strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple projects and tasks to meet congressionally mandated deadlines.
* May also assist in data development, analysis, and presentation for ad hoc and ongoing requests. Data analysis and report development skills using Excel, MS Access, VBA, and/or Python is a plus.

 **Responsibilities:**

* Assist with project management of national laboratory \& competitive funded Building Envelope and Windows R\&D:
	+ Critical reviews and evaluations of project deliverables and R\&D plans and priorities.
	+ Management of scope, time, and budgets.
	+ Supporting project communications plans/outreach and engagement and coordination with BTO to increase impact.
	+ Advising on science and technology best practices.
* Support interagency working groups with information requests, scheduling, development plans, presentations, and reporting.
* Assist BTO development of strategic plans for Built Environment Policy R\&D:
	+ Horizon scanning for new technologies and applications.
	+ Literature reviews and documentation.
	+ Development of out\-year research plans/themes.
	+ Outreach and engagement with industry, NGOs, resource and regulatory agencies, academia, tribes, states, and other stakeholders.
	+ Conference participation and preparation support.
	+ Prepare documents for briefings, sometimes at a quick turnaround time.
	+ Support budget requests and planning.
* Support BTO program technical staff with administrative processes.

 **Requirements:**

* Master’s degree in STEM, Environmental Science, Energy Policy, or a related discipline.
* Self\-starter, an ability to work both independently and as part of a highly dynamic collaborative team
* Experience in active tracking and monitoring government funded research and development projects
* Professional attitude \& strong attention to detail
* Ability to balance multiple long and short\-term projects and competing priorities
* Highly proficient in Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Access, Microsoft Project
* Strong oral and written communication skills in technical reports and presentations
* Must be a U.S. citizen.
* Successful drug screening.
* Must be eligible to obtain and maintain a security or clearance badge.

 **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Ph.D. with research experience.
* 5\+ years’ experience in scientific research environments.
* Experience working with a range of stakeholders, including governments, industry associations, and technical research staff.
* Experience in analysis and other activities that inform federal strategy related to Building Technologies.

 **Location/Work Arrangement:**

* This position can be a Hybrid Work Arrangement or Remote.
* Washington, DC preferred.
* Schedule is full\-time, Monday – Friday 40\-hour week.

 **Benefits:**


BGS offers a competitive total compensation package to eligible employees. Benefits include Health, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, Paid Vacation, 401K, Long and Short\-Term Disability.

 **EEO:**


BGS is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply and will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

jobs.title: Installation Project Manager
jobs.description:
**About IMMERSED**

IMMERSED is the creative and technical division of AKJOHNSTON, delivering integrated systems for themed entertainment, cultural institutions, performance venues, and complex creative environments. Our work blends storytelling, technology, and precision execution. Every Project Manager plays a critical role in transforming client requirements into successfully delivered systems that meet technical, operational, and experiential objectives.

**Position Summary**

The Project Manager is responsible for the planning, coordination, execution, and successful delivery of audiovisual, control, networking, theatrical lighting, architectural lighting, rigging and integrated technology projects. This role serves as the primary point of coordination between clients, consultants, contractors, internal engineering teams, field personnel, and vendors throughout the project lifecycle.

The Project Manager is accountable for project scope, schedule, budget, quality, risk management, procurement, and client communication. The ideal candidate combines strong organizational and leadership skills with a solid understanding of audiovisual systems and integrated technology infrastructure.

**Key Responsibilities**

Project Planning \& Execution

* Lead projects from contract award through final commissioning and project closeout.
* Review contracts, Statements of Work (SOW), engineering documentation, bid drawings, architectural plans, and project specifications to establish project requirements and deliverables.
* Develop and maintain project schedules, milestones, resource plans, and procurement timelines.
* Coordinate internal engineering, programming, fabrication, installation, and commissioning activities.
* Identify project risks, develop mitigation strategies, and proactively manage project challenges.
* Monitor project progress and ensure deliverables remain aligned with contractual obligations and client expectations.

Budgeting \& Financial Management

* Develop and manage project budgets, forecasts, and financial reporting.
* Monitor labor utilization, subcontractor performance, equipment costs, freight expenses, and project profitability.
* Review and approve vendor quotations, purchase orders, and subcontractor proposals.
* Coordinate procurement activities to ensure equipment and materials are delivered according to project schedules.
* Manage project change orders, scope modifications, and client approvals.
* Support project billing, revenue recognition, and financial closeout processes.

Client \& Stakeholder Management

* Serve as the primary point of contact for clients throughout project execution.
* Facilitate project meetings, status updates, coordination sessions, and stakeholder communications.
* Coordinate with architects, consultants, IT departments, general contractors, owners, and third\-party vendors.
* Manage client expectations and communicate project status, schedule impacts, risks, and resolutions.
* Build and maintain strong client relationships that support repeat business opportunities.

Team Leadership \& Coordination

* Lead multidisciplinary project teams consisting of Systems Engineers, Field Engineers, Programmers, Installation Technicians, subcontractors, and vendors.

The Special Investigations Unit (SIU) is responsible for detecting, investigating, and preventing healthcare fraud, waste, and abuse involving providers, facilities, members, and brokers across all lines of business, and for coordinating with law enforcement and regulatory agencies. In this role you serve as the front of the SIU detection pipeline, independently identifying suspect providers and emerging fraud schemes through advanced data mining and claims analysis.


You will quantify financial exposure, develop well\-supported lead packages, and drive the analysis that enables prepayment review placement, investigation, and payment containment. * Maintain accurate loan and security position records and investigate data breaks, settlement fails, and other operational discrepancies across the trade lifecycle
* Ensure compliance with SOX controls, documentation standards, and internal audit requirements
* Partner with internal teams to resolve exceptions and improve operational processes
* Support securitization data preparation by monitoring data quality, completeness, and lineage
* Support margin/collateral processes as needed, including coordinating with counterparties and internal teams

IREN is a vertically integrated AI Cloud provider, delivering large\-scale data centers and GPU clusters for AI training and inference. IREN’s platform is underpinned by its expansive portfolio of grid\-connected land and power in renewable\-rich regions across North America, Europe and APAC.
  

  

With 100% renewable energy, we build, own and operate our data centers and take pride in being at the forefront of sustainable solutions for the ever\-evolving applications of high\-performance compute. We believe that human progress is invaluable, but it should be done in the right way: responsibly, sustainably and having a positive impact on the communities we operate in.
  

  

We are hiring a Business Operations Manager to run the business of Cloud Operations and SRE, and to work 1:1 with the VP who leads it. One role, two halves that reinforce each other: you own how the org plans, reports and follows through, and you own the executive’s time, attention and follow\-through as a system you design and continuously improve.
  

  

We are looking for someone who already runs their own stack of agents and automations, who treats “a human did this manually” as a bug, and who measures themselves by what moved forward — not by what got scheduled.
  

  

If you have been the person on your team quietly building the workflows everyone else asks to borrow, read on.
  

  

What This Role Actually Is
  

* A business operations owner. You run the planning and reporting spine of the org: goals and OKRs, the roadmap, the cross\-functional programs, and the metrics that say whether Cloud Operations and SRE are healthy. You know the numbers before anyone asks for them, and you chase down the ones that do not make sense.
* A program driver. For initiatives that cross teams, you own the plan, the dependencies, the risks and the uncomfortable status update. Nobody should have to ask “what happened with that?”
* An operator. You will run the operating cadence: staff meetings, business reviews, planning cycles, offsites. You will run these end to end: agenda, pre\-reads, decisions captured, owners assigned, follow\-ups driven to closure.
* A force multiplier to the executive, not a filter. The executive support half of this job is a core part of it, not a legacy attachment. You will own the VP’s calendar, inbox, travel and follow\-through, and you will make decisions on their behalf inside clearly defined boundaries widening those boundaries as trust compounds. You understand what good looks like for implementing an agentic stack to be the filter, and the organizational change management necessary to drive the teams to that filter.
* An org operations partner. Headcount and requisition tracking, hiring loops, onboarding that does not depend on tribal knowledge, team communications, and offsites you own outright.
* An automation builder. Every recurring task you touch is a candidate for an agent. Weekly reports, status roll\-ups, meeting prep briefs, inbox triage and drafting, travel logistics, expense reconciliation, doc hygiene — you build it once, monitor it, and move on to the next thing. Your job is to work yourself out of your own to\-do list, repeatedly. There is plenty more to do after all of this is automated; it is why you are a force multiplier and an operator.
* A judgment layer. Automation is cheap; taste is not. You will know which emails only the executive can answer, which meeting genuinely needs 60 minutes, which “urgent” request can wait until Thursday, and which agent output is subtly wrong and must never go out the door.

  
* 5 or more years in business operations, program management, chief\-of\-staff or senior executive support roles, including direct experience supporting a senior executive, and at least some of it in a fast\-moving, high\-ambiguity environment (startup, scale\-up, or a team inside a larger company operating like one).
* Genuinely AI\-native. You use AI assistants and agentic tools every day, not occasionally. You can describe — in specifics — a workflow you automated, what broke, and how you fixed it. Prompting is not a party trick to you; it is how you work. Bonus points if you are well beyond prompting and operating with context and graph loop engineering.
* Hands\-on with agentic tooling. Personal AI agents and assistants for calendar, inbox and scheduling; general\-purpose assistants (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini) as daily drivers; and connective tissue between systems. You do not need to be an engineer. You do need to be unafraid of documentation and have a high level of taste.
* The ability to run a cadence and a program. Agendas, pre\-reads, decision logs, status that is honest when it is bad. You are comfortable holding senior people to commitments they made, in writing, in front of their peers.
* Comfort with numbers. You can build a reporting roll\-up, spot the metric that is lying, and explain a trend to leadership without dressing it up.
* Judgment under incomplete information, or with swinging\-door outcomes. You would rather make a reversible decision now than wait for permission.
* Instinctive discretion. You will sit close to board material, compensation, org changes and unannounced strategy. This is table stakes.

  

Nice to have:
  

* You have built something small and useful with low\-code tools — a script, a dashboard, a bot — because it was faster than asking.
* You have run a planning or OKR cycle for a technical org and lived with the result.

jobs.title: Staff Program Manager, Operations
jobs.description:
Crusoe is on a mission *to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence*. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.


We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy\-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.


We're looking for problem\-solving, opportunity\-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.


If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high\-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.

**About This Role**


Crusoe's Cloud Engineering organization is 380 people today and hiring toward 550\. The operating machinery that got us here — headcount tracked in spreadsheets, all\-hands assembled by hand, action items chased one direct message at a time — does not survive the next 170 people.


This role exists to own that machinery and replace it with systems.


You will own the people and operations layer of Cloud Engineering end to end: headcount and requisition coordination in partnership with our Recruiting team, all\-hands and org events with our EA team, intern and early\-career programs, manager enablement adoption, and the operating rhythms that keep a 380\-person organization legible to its leaders. Today most of the initial intake sits with the Chief of Staff. Tomorrow it sits with you, and it runs whether or not leadership is paying attention to it.


The ideal candidate is a program manager who thinks in operating systems rather than checklists, is fluent in spreadsheets and workflow automation, and is comfortable holding senior engineering leaders to a deadline without formal authority over them.

**What You'll Be Working On**

***Headcount and requisition operations***

* Own the headcount plan of record for Cloud Engineering in partnership with the Recruiting team: reconcile requisitions and position IDs across TeamOhana, Workday, and Finance's forecast into one source of truth that leaders trust and drive adoption of new processes the Talent Acquisition team puts in place.
* Run intake and prioritization for new and backfill requisitions: collect and sequence each leader's critical roles, keep pipeline status current, and flag where teams are net\-short before anyone has to ask.
* Partner with Recruiting and Finance on hiring pace, requisition sequencing, and where budget left on the table can open additional headcount. Build the requisition intake SOP that does not exist today.
* Produce and maintain the org chart and span\-of\-control view that HR, Finance, and Accounting currently have to request one\-off.
* Coordinate the interview machinery around engineering reqs: panel construction, interviewer capacity, and feedback completion. Own whether scorecards land on time.

***All\-hands and org events***

* Own Cloud Engineering All\-Hands coordination end to end: bids for topics, agenda, speaker strategy, deck production, and Q\&A follow\-up.
* Measure it attendance, participation, and satisfaction should trend over time.
* Drive adoption and engagement in engineering tech talks, site\-specific all\-hands, and org\-wide social programming across San Francisco, Dublin, Tel Aviv, and new sites as they come online.

***People programs***

* Own the intern and early\-career program for Cloud Engineering: request cycles, offers, mentor matching, performance tracking, and full\-time conversion. Stand up the pipeline at new sites and coordinate with the Cloud Engineering leadership team.
* Drive adoption of manager training and enablement in partnership with the People team.
* Build the functional onboarding program for engineers and engineering managers joining Cloud Engineering, and measure onboarding satisfaction against a baseline.
* Partner with HR on engagement and pulse survey cycles and Recruiting MBRs: readouts by org, action plans, and follow\-through.

***Operating rhythm and program hygiene***

* Own operating programs and planning calendar for the Chief of Staff organization: staff meetings, reviews, planning cycles, and offsites. What happens when, what pre\-work is due, and who owes what to whom.
* Produce the recurring leadership updates and executive readouts the Chief of Staff and SVP present from.

***Systems and automation***

* Treat every recurring chase as a defect. Replace it with a form, a script, a dashboard, or a scheduled reminder.
* Own the Sheets, Docs, Jira, and Confluence artifacts these programs run on, including structure, access, and hygiene, and migrate them onto real systems where real systems exist.
* Build a repeatable playbook any program manager or engineering manager can pick up and run without you.
* Own the communications and change\-management plan attached to each rollout. Adoption is the deliverable; the announcement is not.

**What You'll Bring to the Team**

* 8\+ years in program management, business operations, or people operations, including time supporting a large engineering or infrastructure organization through fast growth.
* Direct experience owning headcount or workforce planning operations: requisitions, position management, and reconciliation across Finance, Talent, and business leadership.
* A track record running an all\-hands or comparable large\-audience program for an organization of 500\+, with evidence you improved it rather than just de

jobs.description:
Meta's Regulatory Compliance Programs (RCP) is the central engine driving risk management and compliance at the company, supporting Meta and the family of apps. We're seeking experienced GRC, Trust \& Safety, or Security professionals to help enable and safeguard Meta's products and services, which have a truly global scale, by upholding existing Content Regulation requirements and meeting emergent compliance obligations. Regulatory Compliance is responsible for (a) enabling the business to achieve its goals at scale and pace; (b) safeguarding the business against real world security risks; and (c) addressing the regulatory scrutiny the business faces. Our goal is to make Meta the premier place to work for governance, risk, compliance, and Integrity professionals.As a Program Manager on the Compliance \& Assurance team, you will support critical compliance capabilities including New Product Compliance for AI and product launches, accelerated mitigations for new obligations, and integrated reporting to drive decision\-making. You will partner cross\-functionally with Product, Engineering, Legal, and Policy teams to embed compliance evaluations into product lifecycles and enable risk\-reducing measures.The ideal candidate has experience working in ambiguous environments, defining problem spaces as they evolve, and driving alignment across technical and cross\-functional stakeholders.  

  

  

### **Program Manager, Compliance Assurance Responsibilities:**

* Support the execution of Meta's Compliance \& Assurance Programs priorities, including New Product Compliance, Compliance Effectiveness, and cross\-functional initiatives.
* Partner with Product teams to enable risk\-reducing measures including integrated monitoring, reporting, and oversight.
* Embed compliance evaluations into early\-stage product lifecycles, enabling early mitigation and accelerated product launches.
* Leverage AI tools to scale compliance effectiveness, delivering monitoring, oversight artifacts, and continuous improvement recommendations.
* Maintain an in\-depth understanding of the broad regulatory landscape impacting Meta across Integrity, Youth, Privacy, and Security, with the ability to translate changes into actionable program work.
* Prepare compliance materials and support engagement with Leaders, Committees, Regulators, and external auditors.
* Communicate complex and technical concepts effectively to diverse audiences (Engineering, Product, Legal) to enable cross\-functional alignment and decisions.
* Identify critical gaps and risks in strategy, product, or positions, and propose mitigations to resolve them.
* Support AI risk assessment capabilities by executing methodologies, tiering, and operational protocols for predicate, model, and rapid assessments in collaboration with AI Infra, Product, and Legal.
* Drive cross\-domain alignment across Privacy, Integrity, Legal, Compliance, and Internal Audit to implement oversight models.
* Track program metrics, manage deliverables, and support AI and automation initiatives to scale assessment capacity.

  

  

  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 8\+ years of experience in security, technology risk, GRC, trust \& safety, or a related discipline
* Experience partnering with Product, Infrastructure, or Engineering organizations on tech risk or compliance programs
* Experience delivering assurance or reporting against external regulatory or certification regimes (e.g., EU/Global regulatory frameworks, SOC 2, HIPAA, FDA, US Government requirements)
* Experience managing complex, cross\-functional programs involving multiple stakeholders and time\-sensitive deliverables
* Bachelor's Degree or equivalent experience

  

  

  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
* Knowledge of global content regulations, content moderation, and trust \& safety best practices
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Experience working in regulated industries or security
* Experience working in Tech, and using AI tools to improve workflows, strengthen controls, and enable compliance
